lines.speaker: WARDEN
lines.text: Intrusion detected on floor four. Kestrel Dynamics is now in lockdown.

lines.speaker: WARDEN
lines.text: All exits are sealed. Fire suppression will flood this floor in ten minutes.

lines.speaker: Dee
lines.text: Hey, it's Dee from building ops. WARDEN has you flagged as the intruder. Get the power back first. The breaker panel is on the back wall, and someone pulled its fuses.

lines.speaker: Dee
lines.text: Lights are back. Kowalski's office is sealed, but the maintenance catwalk runs right over it. Climb the ladder by the storage shelves.

lines.speaker: Dee
lines.text: Grab the rungs with your grip buttons and pull yourself up. Try not to look down.

lines.speaker: Dee
lines.text: You're in. Kowalski keeps the override card in that office, and his safe has the vault battery.

lines.speaker: Dee
lines.text: That wall clock has been stopped for weeks. He was always strange about that clock.

lines.speaker: Dee
lines.text: Old dial safe. Turn it slowly. You will feel it catch when you land on the right number.

lines.speaker: Dee
lines.text: The vault lock needs a laser on its sensor. Power the emitter, then turn the mirrors.

lines.speaker: Dee
lines.text: Card in the slot, then hold the reboot button until it finishes. Do not let go.

lines.speaker: WARDEN
lines.text: Reboot complete. Lockdown lifted. Have a pleasant night.
